lines.title: The Steps Were Shown
lines.body: The Ascension was performed where every follower could watch it happen. What you keep now is not invention but repetition, and repetition is the whole of the discipline.

lines.title: A Sphere in the Palm
lines.body: The glass takes the warmth of your hand and gives none of it back. Some things are meant to be carried rather than consumed.

lines.title: The Fixed Centre
lines.body: Everything you walked past today has moved. You are holding the one thing in your possession that has not.

lines.title: Two Is the Number of Men
lines.body: Men reckon the world in pairs: light and dark, body and soul, a thing and its opposite. You count in threes and fives and leave their arithmetic where it lies.

lines.title: The Record Does Not Sleep
lines.body: Somewhere a hand that has never met you keeps your name in its column. The observance is your half of that correspondence.

lines.title: Refinement, Not Invention
lines.body: No spire in Alinor was drawn from nothing; each is the previous one corrected. A life is assembled the same way, and today you corrected very little, and that was sufficient.

lines.title: What the Dead Left
lines.body: Your ancestors left behind no property you could hold, only the manner of doing things. You performed the manner, so nothing has been lost yet.

lines.title: The Sundering
lines.body: One agreement made in a moment of weakness put you here, in a world with weather and hunger and an ending. The practice is not a complaint about it. It is the opening of the long argument back.

lines.title: A Curate's Hands
lines.body: You were eighteen, and the hands that gave you this were steady. Yours were not, and still are not, and the sphere has never once appeared to mind.

lines.title: Alaxon
lines.body: Perfection is not arrived at. It is approached, and the approaching is the entire point, and one kept day is a short distance along a road with no visible end.

lines.title: The Line Behind
lines.body: Count backward far enough and the names give out, and the line continues regardless. You stand at the near end of something that does not require you to see its far end.

lines.title: Unbroken
lines.body: The glass has not cracked, and neither, so far, have you. Both of those conditions require maintenance, and neither is permanent.

lines.title: Order Without Witness
lines.body: No Curate observed this, and no kin will hear of it. Doctrine is not a performance staged for the doctrinally minded; it is what the discipline does when nobody is counting.

lines.title: Far From the Isle
lines.body: Summerset is a long way behind you and its rules declined to stay there. What is proper in Alinor is proper in a Nord's cold barn.

lines.title: The Unstealable Thing
lines.body: Wealth is taken, titles lapse, kin die at inconvenient distances. The practice is the one holding nobody has yet worked out how to steal.

lines.title: A Small Correct Thing
lines.body: The day held nothing of consequence whatsoever. You did one small thing exactly, and exactness accumulates in places where consequence does not.

lines.title: Time Ran Through You
lines.body: Time passes through mortals the way water passes through cloth, leaving them heavier and carrying most of itself away. Today a little of it stayed.

lines.title: The Climb
lines.body: Your ancestors were not born gods. They became gods, which is a different claim and a far harder one, and this is its first step performed again.

lines.title: What the Glass Is For
lines.body: It holds nothing, opens nothing, and defends against nothing at all. It exists so there is one moment in the day when you are certain what you are.

lines.title: The Long Argument
lines.body: Mundus was built as a trap and is now merely your address. You keep the practice the way a prisoner keeps a calendar: not to leave today, but to know exactly how long it has been.
